description: List what was added to the Anime News Network encyclopedia most recently: anime, manga, people or companies. Pass 'starts_with' to browse titles alphabetically instead, which only applies to anime and manga. Rows carry an id you can pass to get_title when the kind is anime or manga. This walks the catalogue in order: use search_titles when you know the title you are after.

offset.description: How many rows to skip, for paging.

starts_with.description: Single letter. Switches to an alphabetical browse of titles. Anime and manga only.

name: list_recent

mode.description: 'recent' is by date added, 'browse' is alphabetical.

next_offset.description: Pass as 'offset' for the next page. Null when the last page came back short.

title: List recent or browse alphabetically
